statement: Random events Roundup event shows up every hour and pops up exactly like happy hour
There is a one in four chance to get one of the four total random events
You can only do the random event once a day; he thinks it is based on daily reset
Doing it with a party increases the drop rate of the items; your character drop rate has nothing to do with it
Ideally you want a group of ten for random events though getting ten is hard even in happy hour
He suspects random events are a test for something bigger so suggests joining a community guild or Discord to find groups
Random events have seven brand new rewards including a hat a chat ring a couple of ovals and small items like black pearl or dice
The rewards are pretty good and the ovals might be best in slot
The Boar Bean and the frogs map have been neutered to be easier to traverse but kill count and AFK games are unchanged
Ghost drop rate increased so players stuck on the Epon quest no longer need to kill 100K moonmen to get one ghost
Crafting costs for ghost increased; for instance Dewdrop Jedi? usually cost one ghost now costs five
Unattainable items removed from slab and previous dungeon weapons added retroactively; higher rank players who cannot get them will see them showing in the slab
He is almost back at 1300 slab
Atom collider was crashing some players games and that has officially been fixed
Atom collider threshold changed from 1 billion to 1.05 billion for bubbles costing 1 billion per upgrade; you keep your green stacks
New vial tab shows your next possible vial instead of guessing what your new vial is
3D printer with hair god times 3 and lab node times 2 now equal out and show a new color
Ancient stake values were fixed for players far enough in World 5 sailing so you should see an increase in DPS
Divinity Zen style the level 60 style giving 8x B and 8 divinity points has been fixed
Sailing was fixed so escaping the menu no longer stops sailing tracking progress to prevent capping on a chest
Opening the menu can still produce the same effect and still needs fixing soon
He thinks the update is pretty good but a little underwhelming given the hype around random events
Lava plans to release the new classes next with new talents: Siege Breaker Elemental Sorcerer and Divine Knight
New item beautiful Anvil reset wet stone lets players who put points in XP or capacity for Anvil production move them into speed
